2609.20067.title: FCA-Guided Counterfactual Explanations for Multi-Modal Breast Cancer Diagnosis: A Framework Achieving Perfect Validity with Emergent Sparsity
2609.20067.paper_summary: Deep learning models for multi-modal breast cancer diagnosis achieve high predictive accuracy but remain clinically unacceptable without actionable, counterfactual explanations. Attribution-based methods (LIME, SHAP) are categorically inapplicable to this purpose, as they generate no alternative instances and thus cannot be evaluated on counterfactual quality metrics. This investigation provides empirical evidence that FCA-Guided Counterfactual (FCA-CF) framework that uses a Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) concept lattice as a hard structural constraint on counterfactual search, operating over a multi-modal TCGA-BRCA dataset. We benchmark against four genuine counterfactual methods: Wachter-style CF, DiCE, FACE, and NICE, evaluated on 60 benign-predicted TCGA-BRCA instances. The FCA-CF framework achieves Validity = 1.0000 (100% of counterfactuals successfully flip the prediction), Sparsity = 2.37 features changed (best among all valid methods), and Proximity = 0.900 (normalised L2-based, matching NICE as joint best). The classifier achieves Accuracy = 0.980, F1 = 0.976, ROC-AUC = 0.9947. Ablation analysis confirms that the FCA lattice constraint is the primary sparsity driver (removing it increases sparsity by +40%, p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 0.78), while Phase C greedy refinement accounts for the largest individual contribution (+113% sparsity increase when disabled, p < 0.001, d = 5.01). FCA-guided counterfactual generation achieves a clinically important Pareto-dominant outcome; it is simultaneously the sparsest and among the most proximate of all valid methods, with perfect validity. The emergent sparsity property arising from lattice topology rather than numerical penalty terms constitutes a structurally novel contribution to the counterfactual explanation literature.
2609.20067.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習模型在多模態乳腺癌診斷中達到了高預測準確率，但在沒有可行的反事實解釋的情況下仍然無法臨床接受。基於歸因的方法（LIME、SHAP）在這個目的上是根本不適用的，因為它們不生成替代實例，因此無法在反事實質量指標上進行評估。本研究提供了實證證據，表明FCA引導的反事實（FCA-CF）框架使用形式概念分析（FCA）概念格作為反事實搜索的硬結構約束，並在多模態TCGA-BRCA數據集上運行。我們與四種真實的反事實方法進行基準測試：Wachter風格CF、DiCE、FACE和NICE，並在60個良性預測的TCGA-BRCA實例上進行評估。FCA-CF框架達到了有效性= 1.0000（100%的反事實成功翻轉預測），稀疏性= 2.37個變更特徵（在所有有效方法中最佳），以及接近度= 0.900（基於標準化L2，與NICE並列最佳）。分類器達到了準確率= 0.980，F1= 0.976，ROC-AUC= 0.9947。消融分析確認FCA格約束是主要的稀疏性驅動因素（移除它會使稀疏性增加40%以上，p < 0.001，Cohen's d = 0.78），而C階段的貪婪細化則佔據了最大的個別貢獻（禁用時稀疏性增加113%，p < 0.001，d = 5.01）。FCA引導的反事實生成實現了一個臨床重要的Pareto優勢結果；它同時是所有有效方法中最稀疏的，並且接近度最高，具有完美的有效性。來自格拓撲而非數值懲罰項的稀疏性新特性構成了對反事實解釋文獻的結構性新貢獻。
